method: Per company: median of its reported values in the last 4 quarters (working-capital days are reported half-yearly, so 1-2 points). Peer median / range = median, min and max of those company medians. Needs >= 2 companies, else grey. Source: NSE XBRL result filings via the Detective Engine (data/detective/evidence.json). No AI, no estimates.

no_benchmark.creditor_days: Creditor (payables) days are not extracted from the filings yet.
no_benchmark.capacity_utilisation: Listed peers do not report capacity utilisation in XBRL results.
no_benchmark.dscr: DSCR needs repayment schedules that results filings do not carry; interest cover is shown as context only, never used to flag.

textile_chain.label: Listed textile chain (Gujarat-linked)
textile_chain.fit: Nearest listed peers for Surat weaving/processing: Filatex (polyester yarn, Dahej, supplies Surat weavers), Arvind (fabrics, Ahmedabad), Welspun Living (home textiles, Anjar). Large listed firms, not like-for-like with an SME weaver: they usually have better scale, pricing and collection, so an SME projecting BETTER numbers than them needs proof.

cotton_chain.label: Listed cotton textile peers (Gujarat-linked)
cotton_chain.fit: Arvind (denim/woven fabric, Ahmedabad) and Welspun Living (cotton home textiles, Anjar). Integrated exporters, not spinners or ginners: margins and working capital differ from a standalone spinning or ginning unit.

mmf_yarn.label: Listed polyester yarn peer
mmf_yarn.fit: Only one listed MMF-yarn witness (Filatex) is in the Detective universe, so flags stay grey; figures shown for context.

tiles_listed.label: Listed tile makers (Morbi-linked)
tiles_listed.fit: Kajaria and Somany (national brands with Morbi JV/associate units) and Asian Granito (Himmatnagar/Morbi). Branded, dealer-network companies: a standalone Morbi unit usually has thinner margins and longer dealer credit.

chemicals_listed.label: Listed Gujarat chemical makers
chemicals_listed.fit: Atul (Valsad), Deepak Nitrite (Vadodara/Dahej), Aarti Industries (Vapi/Bharuch), Navin Fluorine (Surat/Dahej). Large integrated firms with export customers; an SME dye or intermediate maker usually has thinner margins and less pricing power.

capital_goods_listed.label: Listed Gujarat capital-goods makers
capital_goods_listed.fit: Elecon (gears and material handling, Vallabh Vidyanagar) and Thermax (boilers and process equipment). Project-based order books; a Rajkot job-shop or pump maker is smaller and more dependent on a few buyers.

auto_parts_listed.label: Listed auto-component and forging makers
auto_parts_listed.fit: Bharat Forge (forgings) and Samvardhana Motherson (components). Global OEM suppliers, far larger than a Rajkot casting or component unit; use as a ceiling, not a match.

ports_listed.label: Listed port and logistics operators (Gujarat)
ports_listed.fit: Adani Ports (Mundra), Gujarat Pipavav Port and Container Corporation. Infrastructure owners with long-term contracts; a Kandla-Gandhidham transporter or warehouse operator has far thinner margins.
